answer.rationale: The cancel command changes Booking and also creates and saves a separate AuditEntry. The entry has its own id and refers to the booking only by id. It is built in the service rather than inside Booking, so it looks like a second aggregate saved in the same unit of work. The rule says a domain-event handler should do this. AuditRecord.ts is not shown, so this is inferred from how the code uses it.
